_about: The bag items, final (Jon bought them 23 Oct 2026; docs/handoff-2026-10-23.md section 15, added 24 Oct). Safe content: Jon may read it all. The PACKING (which bag holds which items) is sealed and made blind by scripts/pack-bags.mjs. One line per item, in the workshop's format: Item — sense: word; sense: word · kind · stock N · looks like: note · tag: tag. The kind is 'food, two singles' (two candies go in the bag), 'food, one pack' (one pack, tube or zip bag), 'touch' or 'extra'. Every bag gets one food, at least one touch item, then extras up to 4 or 5 items. Colors and flavors only help Jenna tell items apart; except for the six balls, Jenna may pick any one of a line. The tag (spooky, fun, no-no) is for Sir Irwin's prompts only and is never a clue word.

never._about: True, but bad clues (section 15.2). Never a clue word.
